Module cave_hold "A cave hold" {
  Description "A cave in a hillside behind a screen of brambles: a mouth where the watch sits, a smoky cavern, a ledge up a notched log where the chief sleeps, a pit for captives, a dry side-cave for plunder, a crack that looks out over the road, and a chimney that comes out on the hillside above.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place land "The region" is region.
  Place outside "The approach" is room.

  Place lair "the cave" is site within land.
  Place mouth "the cave mouth" is room within lair at 0, 1.
  Place cavern "the smoky cavern" is room within lair at 1, 1.
  Place ledge "the high ledge" is room within lair at 1, 0.
  Place pit "the captives' pit" is room within lair at 2, 1.
  Place cache "a dry side-cave" is room within lair at 2, 0.
  Place crack "the spy-crack" is room within lair at 0, 0.
  Place hillside "the hillside above the cave" is room within lair at 1, 2.
  Initially Assert unlit(pit). Initially Assert unlit(cache). Initially Assert unlit(crack). Initially Assert indoors(cavern).

  Passage brambles "the brambles across the cave mouth" is passage between outside and mouth taking 10 minutes.
  Passage cave_throat "the throat of the cave" is passage between mouth and cavern.
  Passage notched_log "a notched log" is climb between cavern and ledge.
  Passage pit_rope "a rope ladder down into the pit" is climb between cavern and pit.
  Passage cache_crawl "a crawl into the side-cave" is crawl between cavern and cache.
  Passage crack_way "a cleft in the wall" is passage between mouth and crack.
  Passage chimney "the chimney" is climb between cavern and hillside taking 30 minutes hidden until backway_known needing climbing or rope.
  Passage hill_path "a goat-track down the hillside" is path between hillside and outside taking 20 minutes.

  Observe mouth_scene at mouth when true "The cave mouth, behind its brambles: a fire-blackened ceiling, gnawed bones, and a stool for whoever keeps watch.".
  Observe cavern_scene at cavern when true "A big smoky cavern with a fire in the middle and the smoke going up into a black hole in the roof. A notched log leans against the wall up to a ledge; a rope ladder hangs into a pit.".
  Observe ledge_scene at ledge when true "A ledge high in the cavern wall, out of the smoke: a bed of skins, and a chest.".
  Observe pit_scene at pit when true "A pit with sheer sides and a muck floor. You would not climb out of it without the rope.".
  Observe cache_scene at cache when true "A dry side-cave stacked with plunder.".
  Observe crack_scene at crack when true "A cleft in the rock that looks straight down on the road below.".
  Observe hillside_scene at hillside when true "The open hillside above the cave. Smoke comes out of a hole among the rocks.".
  Observe chimney_hint at cavern when not knows(party, backway_known) "The smoke goes up the hole in the roof as if it had somewhere to go.".

  Thing chest "a chest on the ledge" at ledge {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "A chest stands on the ledge, locked.".
    State open "The chest on the ledge stands open.".
    Change pick "Pick the chest's lock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change smash "Break the chest open" from locked to open needing brawn.
  }
  Thing heap "a heap of plunder" at cache {
    Holds.
  }
  Discovery backway_known "The smoke-hole in the cave's roof is a chimney that comes out on the hillside above; a climber could go up or down it." {
    Found by searching cavern "Up the smoke-hole there is daylight, and a crack worn by hands and feet: a chimney, and someone climbs it.".
    Found by searching outside with woodcraft "Up the hillside, smoke comes out of a hole among the rocks, and there is a goat-track to it.".
    Found by searching hillside "Among the rocks the smoke comes out of a crack you could climb down, with a rope or a good grip.".
  }
  Goal false.
}

Module ringfort "A ring-fort" {
  Description "An old earth ring on a rise: a ditch and a bank topped with stakes, a stake gate, a yard, a long hall roofed with turf over a store-pit, a lookout mound, and a souterrain from the pit that comes out among the gorse below.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place land "The region" is region.
  Place outside "The approach" is room.

  Place fort "the ring-fort" is site within land.
  Place under "Under the hall" is level within fort.
  Place ditch "the ditch under the bank" is room within fort at 0, 2.
  Place yard "the yard inside the ring" is room within fort at 1, 1.
  Place hall "the long hall" is room within fort at 1, 0.
  Place den "the far end of the hall" is room within fort at 2, 0.
  Place pens "the pens" is room within fort at 2, 1.
  Place mound "the lookout mound" is room within fort at 0, 1.
  Place gorse "a hole among the gorse" is room within fort at 2, 2.
  Place pit "the store-pit" is room within under at 1, 0.
  Initially Assert unlit(pit). Initially Assert indoors(hall). Initially Assert indoors(den).

  Passage bank_path "the path up the bank" is path between outside and ditch taking 20 minutes.
  Passage stake_gate "the stake gate" is gate between ditch and yard.
  Passage hall_door "the hall door" is door between yard and hall.
  Passage hide_curtain "a curtain of hides" is doorway between hall and den.
  Passage pen_hurdle "the pen hurdle" is gate between yard and pens.
  Passage mound_steps "the steps up the mound" is steps between yard and mound.
  Passage pit_ladder "the ladder down into the store-pit" is ladder between hall and pit.
  Passage souterrain "the souterrain" is crawl between pit and gorse taking 30 minutes hidden until backway_known.
  Passage gorse_path "a way out through the gorse" is path between gorse and outside taking 20 minutes hidden until backway_known.

  Observe ditch_scene at ditch when true "A deep ditch under a bank of turf, and along the top of the bank a fence of stakes as tall as a man. Things hang from the stakes and turn in the wind: bones, rags, a doll.".
  Observe yard_scene at yard when true "The yard inside the ring is trodden mud, with a long turf-roofed hall, a hurdle pen, and a mound with a lookout's seat on top.".
  Observe hall_scene at hall when true "The long hall is low and smoky, with a fire in a pit down the middle and sleeping-straw along the walls. A ladder goes down through a hole in the floor at one end.".
  Observe den_scene at den when true "The far end of the hall, behind hides: a heap of fleeces like a throne, and a chest.".
  Observe pens_scene at pens when true "Hurdle pens, mucky, full of somebody else's sheep.".
  Observe mound_scene at mound when true "From the top of the mound you can see the road for miles, and anyone on it.".
  Observe pit_scene at pit when true "A pit under the hall, roofed with timber, full of plunder. In the far wall a low stone-lined passage goes off into the dark, and a draught comes down it that smells of gorse.".
  Observe gorse_scene at gorse when true "A hole among the gorse below the ring, half hidden, worn smooth at the lip.".

  Thing chest "a chest under the fleeces" at den {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "The chest under the fleeces is locked, with a padlock as big as a fist.".
    State open "The chest under the fleeces stands open.".
    Change pick "Pick the chest's padlock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change smash "Smash the chest's padlock" from locked to open needing brawn.
  }
  Thing heap "a heap of plunder" at pit {
    Holds.
  }
  Discovery backway_known "A passage leaves the ring-fort's store-pit and comes out in a hole among the gorse below the ring." {
    Found by searching pit "The draught comes from a souterrain, a stone-lined crawl going off under the bank.".
    Found by searching outside with woodcraft "Among the gorse below the ring, a hole worn smooth at the lip, and the smell of smoke coming out of it.".
  }
  Goal false.
}

Module brackenholt "Brackenholt and the holt" {
  Description "The east bank of the Serewater: Brackenholt, a woodcutters' village under an old watchtower, and the holt of bracken and oak between it and the downs. Wren's ferry crosses from Reedwake; the long way round passes a bears' den.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place march "The region" is region.
  Place quay "Reedwake quay" is room.
  Place home "The ferry house" is room.
  Place cross_green "Chalkcross green" is room.
  Entity missing: group "The one who went missing".
  Entity waiting: group "The one who waits".

  Place holt "the Holt" is wilderness within march at 1, 2.
  Place brackenholt "Brackenholt" is settlement within march at 0, 2.
  Place holly_bush "The Holly Bush" is building within brackenholt.
  Place landing "Brackenholt landing" is room within brackenholt at 0, 0.
  Place holt_green "Brackenholt green" is room within brackenholt at 1, 0.
  Place holly_room "the Holly Bush taproom" is room within holly_bush at 1, 1.
  Place den_clearing "the bear clearing" is room within holt at 1, 0.
  Place holt_edge "the edge of the holt" is room within holt at 2, 0.
  Place tower_foot "Holt tower" is room within holt at 0, 1.
  Place churchyard "Brackenholt churchyard" is room within brackenholt at 2, 0.

  Passage ferry_crossing "Wren's ferry" is ferry between quay and landing taking 30 minutes.
  Passage landing_lane "the landing lane" is path between landing and holt_green.
  Passage holly_door "the Holly Bush door" is door between holly_room and holt_green.
  Passage holt_west "the holt way down from the downs" is path between cross_green and holt_edge taking 1 hour.
  Passage holt_mid "the holt way through the bracken" is path between holt_edge and den_clearing taking 30 minutes.
  Passage holt_east "the holt way into Brackenholt" is path between den_clearing and holt_green taking 1 hour.
  Passage tower_lane "the tower lane" is track between holt_green and tower_foot taking 30 minutes.
  Passage lychgate "the lychgate" is gate between holt_green and churchyard.

  Thing ferry "Wren's ferry" on ferry_crossing {
    State tied blocking "Wren's ferry is tied up at the quay steps. Nobody else will take it out while its keeper waits for news.".
    State running "Wren's ferry rides at the quay steps, ready to cross.".
  }
  Event ferry_free near ferry when state(ferry, tied) and at(missing, home) "Wren comes down to the steps and slaps the ferry's gunwale. 'Anywhere you need on this river, and no charge. Not while I keep the ferry.'" then {
    Assert state(ferry, running).
  }

  Person bears "the bears of the holt" at den_clearing {
    Role "a sow bear and her grown cub". Species bear. Numbers 2. Called "the sow", "the cub".
    State denning blocking "A sow bear and her grown cub have denned in the bracken across the holt way. The sow rises on her hind legs and blows at you.".
    State gone "Trampled bracken and the smell of old smoke where the bears denned. The holt way is clear.".
    Guards holt_mid. Guards holt_east.
    Change smoke "Lay green wood upwind and smoke {self} out of the bracken" from denning to gone needing woodcraft.
  }
  Rule bears_leave when state(bears, gone) and at(bears, den_clearing) { Retract at(bears, den_clearing). }

  Person osric "Osric" at holly_room {
    Role "landlord of the Holly Bush". Profession innkeeper. Peaceable.
    Sells rations for 2 coin from 6.
    Sells torch for 1 coin from 4.
  }
  Person agnes "Agnes" at holt_green {
    Role "sexton of Brackenholt". Ancestry human. Peaceable.
  }
  Person cutter "Wat" at holly_room {
    Role "woodcutter". Ancestry human. Peaceable.

  Entity intelligence: quality "Intelligence". Entity wisdom: quality "Wisdom". Entity charisma: quality "Charisma".

Module world_passages "Passages, obstacles and the condition of things" {
  Kind passage. Kind condition. Kind change. Kind thing. Kind waykind. Kind hazard.
  // What is seen and changes but is not handled: the weather, a river, a beacon on a far hill.
  Kind scenery.
  Relation passageKind(passage, waykind). Measure travelTime(passage).
  Relation connects(passage, place, place).
  Relation on(entity, passage).
  Relation guards(group, passage).
  Relation state(entity, condition) exclusive.
  Relation blocksWhen(entity, condition). Relation harmsWhen(entity, condition).
  Relation hurtsWith(entity, hazard). Relation hurtsInto(entity, condition).
  Relation revealedBy(entity, fact).
  // Containment: a thing or item inside another, reachable while that one is not shut; a receptacle can take more.
  Relation inside(entity, entity). Relation receptacle(entity). Relation closesWhen(entity, condition).
  // A hazard that strikes a company: the world turns it on one of its members (a trap sprung, a stone that falls).
  Relation strikes(hazard, group).
  // What can be tried on a thing (looked over closely, prodded, pried at...), and what has been.
  Kind verb. Relation probeable(entity). Relation tried(entity, verb).
  Relation needs(entity, entity).
  Relation changeOf(change, entity). Relation changeFrom(change, condition). Relation changeTo(change, condition).
  Relation changeKnows(change, fact). Relation consumes(change, good). Relation spends(change, itemkind).
  Relation hobbled(group).
  Relation following(group, group).
  Query holding(a: group, k: itemkind) means memberOf(?m, a) and ownedItem(?i, ?m) and itemKind(?i, k).
  Query meets(a: group, n: entity) means capable(a, n) or holding(a, n) or (following(a, ?l) and holding(?l, n)).
  Query equippedFor(a: group, x: entity) means not needs(x, ?n) or (needs(x, ?n) and meets(a, ?n)).
  Query informedFor(a: group, c: change) means not changeKnows(c, ?f) or (changeKnows(c, ?f) and knows(a, ?f)).
  Query visibleTo(w: passage, a: group) means not revealedBy(w, ?f) or (revealedBy(w, ?f) and knows(a, ?f))
    or (revealedBy(w, ?g) and following(a, ?l) and knows(?l, ?g)).
  Query barred(w: passage) means on(?o, w) and state(?o, ?s) and blocksWhen(?o, ?s).
  // Who holds the key to what bars a way, and those who serve them, go through it as if it were open.
  Relation keyholder(group, entity).
  Query opens(a: group, o: entity) means keyholder(a, o) or (serves(a, ?m) and keyholder(?m, o)).
  Query barredFor(w: passage, a: group) means on(?o, w) and state(?o, ?s) and blocksWhen(?o, ?s) and not opens(a, ?o).
  Query watched(w: passage) means guards(?g, w) and able(?g) and state(?g, ?t) and blocksWhen(?g, ?t)
    and at(?g, ?p) and connects(w, ?p, ?q).
  Query obstructed(w: passage) means barred(w) or watched(w).
  Query watchedAgainst(w: passage, a: group) means guards(?g, w) and able(?g) and state(?g, ?t) and blocksWhen(?g, ?t)
    and at(?g, ?p) and connects(w, ?p, ?q) and not allied(?g, a) and not tolerates(?g, a).
  Query hazardous(w: passage) means on(?h, w) and state(?h, ?s) and harmsWhen(?h, ?s).
  Query mobile(a: group) means not hobbled(a) or following(a, ?l).
  Query together(a: group, b: group) means at(a, ?p) and at(b, ?p).
  Query shut(c: entity) means state(c, ?s) and closesWhen(c, ?s).
  // A thing hidden until something is known is not there, for a company that does not know it; nor is a thing on a way
  // the company does not know of.
  Query onHiddenWay(x: entity, a: group) means on(x, ?w) and not visibleTo(?w, a).
  Query noticed(x: entity, a: group) means (not revealedBy(x, ?f) or (revealedBy(x, ?f) and knows(a, ?f)))
    and not onHiddenWay(x, a).
  Query reaches(a: group, t: entity) means noticed(t, a) and ((at(a, ?p) and at(t, ?p))
    or (at(a, ?q) and on(t, ?w) and connects(?w, ?q, ?r))
    or (at(a, ?q) and guards(t, ?w) and connects(?w, ?q, ?r) and at(t, ?r))
    or (at(a, ?h) and inside(t, ?c) and at(?c, ?h) and not shut(?c))).
  Query passable(w: passage, a: group) means visibleTo(w, a) and not barredFor(w, a) and not watchedAgainst(w, a)
    and not hazardous(w)
    and equippedFor(a, w).
  Goal false.

  Action go(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place) "Take {way} to {destination}" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and passable(way, actor)
      and mobile(actor).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert at(actor, destination). }
    Seen "{actor} takes {way} toward {destination}.".
  }
  Action slip_past(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place, gatekeeper: group) "Slip past {gatekeeper} by {way}" {
    Description "Someone who moves quietly takes the company past a watcher without a fight or a bargain. The watcher stays where it is, and will be there on the way back.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and guards(gatekeeper, way)
      and able(gatekeeper) and state(gatekeeper, ?t) and blocksWhen(gatekeeper, ?t) and not tolerates(gatekeeper, actor)
      and (at(gatekeeper, origin) or at(gatekeeper, destination))
      and capable(actor, stealth)
      and visibleTo(way, actor) and not barred(way) and not hazardous(way) and equippedFor(actor, way) and mobile(actor).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert at(actor, destination). }
    Result "One at a time, keeping low and downwind, you slip past {gatekeeper}.".
  }
  Action risk(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place, trap: entity, blow: hazard, after: condition, victim: member) "Risk {trap}; {victim} goes first" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and on(trap, way)
      and state(trap, ?s) and harmsWhen(trap, ?s) and hurtsWith(trap, blow) and hurtsInto(trap, after)
      and memberOf(victim, actor) and awake(victim) and visibleTo(way, actor) and not obstructed(way)
      and equippedFor(actor, way) and mobile(actor).
    Resolve expose(blow, victim).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert state(trap, after). Assert at(actor, destination). }
    On failure { Assert state(trap, after). }
  }
  Action change_thing(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition) "{how}" {
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and not consumes(how, ?g) and not spends(how, ?k).
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). }
  }
  Action change_thing_spending(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition, spent: item, form: itemkind, carrier: member) "{how}, using {carrier}'s {spent}" {
    Description "What it takes is used up doing it.".
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and spends(how, form) and memberOf(carrier, actor) and awake(carrier)
      and ownedItem(spent, carrier) and itemKind(spent, form).
    Resolve drop(spent, carrier).
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). }
  }
  Action change_thing_paying(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition, spent: good) "{how}" {
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and consumes(how, spent) and quantity(actor, spent) >= 1.
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). Decrease quantity(actor, spent) by 1. }
  }
}

  Passage chalk_fault "the chalk fault" is crawl between chalk and drain_mouth taking 30 minutes hidden until chalk_exit.

  Person boar "a reedbank boar" at causeway {
    Role "a boar rooting in the reeds". Species boar. Level 1.
    State rooting blocking "A boar has rooted up the low path and stands across it, bristling, watching you.".
    State wary "The boar has drawn off into the sedge. The low path is clear.".
    Guards low_path.
    Change pass "Read {self}'s warning posture and give it room" from rooting to wary needing woodcraft.
    Change bait "Scatter a ration for {self} away from the path" from rooting to wary consuming rations.
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(boar) to 10.

  Person hound "Ash" at gallery {
    Role "a cave hound". Species cave_hound. Level 2.
    State guarding blocking "A lean cave hound stands across the hoist passage, head low, lips back from its teeth.".
    State calm "The cave hound lies in the mould dust, watching, no longer barring the hoist passage.".
    Guards hoist_passage.
    Change soothe "Approach {self} slowly, low and quiet" from guarding to calm needing woodcraft.
    Change feed "Toss {self} a ration" from guarding to calm consuming rations.
  }
  Event growl near hound when state(hound, guarding) and together(party, hound) "The hound's growl fills the gallery. It does not come at you; it holds the hoist passage.".
  Initially Set encounterXp(hound) to 20.
  Person hesta "Hesta" at gallery {
    Role "the foundry's herb gatherer". Profession herbalist. Peaceable.

    Sells rations for 2 coin from 2.
  }
  Topic hesta_help with hesta "Ask Hesta about Ash and the hill" when not refusesService(hesta, actor) {
    Says "'Ash kept me company after the foundry closed. Give him space, a little food, or that quiet hunter's look. I'll dress your wounds if you need it. But don't strike him in front of me and then ask me to patch you up. The ward blade is still in the valve chamber; fire runs along it, but no steel will turn a steam jet. And the dry stair from the stores goes down to the old refuge without trusting the hoist.'".
  }
  Event hesta_refuses near hesta when witnessedAttack(hesta, party, hound) "Hesta draws the linen basket to her chest. 'I saw you strike Ash. Find your salve elsewhere.'" then { Assert refusesService(hesta, party). }
  Topic hesta_after with hesta "Speak to Hesta after the fight" when refusesService(hesta, actor) {
    Says "'Nera keeps a shop in town. I will not stop you leaving, but I won't serve you.'".
  }

  Item ward_focus "the warder's copper focus" is warding_focus at workshop.
  Item line_cache "a surveyor's harness and pitons" is climbing_harness at stores.
  Item names_lantern "the lantern of names" is lantern_of_names at name_room.
  Item register_copy "the waxed refuge register" is burial_register at name_room.

  Person sentinel "the bronze boiler sentinel" at boiler {
    Role "an abandoned inspection construct". Species bronze_construct. Level 1.
  }
  Observe sentinel_warning at boiler when able(sentinel) "A squat bronze inspector turns on stiff joints. Its plated body resists steel and cannot be poisoned. The arch and pipe walk remain open; nothing compels you to fight it.".
  Item ward_sword "the foundry's Longsword of Flames" is longsword_of_flames at boiler.
  Hazard foundry_steam "Scalding foundry steam" means "Deal (1d6) fire damage to ally unless dexterity save against (11).".
  Thing steam_pipe "the split steam pipe" on boiler_arch {
    State leaking dangerous "A split pipe hisses over the boiler arch. Fresh scorch marks stripe the boiler arch; turning its seized valve needs a crowbar. A fire ward can blunt a scald, but the jet must still be crossed.".
    State shut "The pipe's valve is turned hard shut. The boiler arch is clear.".
    State vented "The old pipe has vented its last pressure. Wet stone steams underfoot.".
    Change close "Turn the steam valve with a bar" from leaking to shut needing crowbar.
    Hurts with foundry_steam when leaking then vented.
  }
  Thing padlock "the stores padlock" on stores_door {
    State locked blocking "A rusted padlock holds the stores door shut.".
    State open "The stores door stands open; its padlock hangs from the hasp.".
    Change pick "Pick the stores padlock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change wrench "Wrench the padlock's hasp out of the rotten door" from locked to open needing brawn.
  }

  Hazard counterweight_drop "The hoist counterweight" means "Deal (2d6) physical damage to ally unless dexterity save against (12).".
  Thing counterweight "the hoist counterweight" on hoist_shaft {
    State armed dangerous "An uncovered counterweight hangs over the shaft. It releases when the cable takes weight.".
    State pinned "A wedge holds the counterweight's release. The shaft is safe to climb.".
    State braced "A line is lashed around the counterweight. It will not fall.".
    State sprung "The counterweight lies at the bottom of the shaft, its cable slack.".
    Change pin "Pin the counterweight's release" from armed to pinned needing trapwork after learning hoist_warning.
    Change brace "Lash {self} with a line" from armed to braced needing rope after learning hoist_warning.
    Hurts with counterweight_drop when armed then sprung.
  }
  Hazard kitchen_vapour "Sealed kitchen vapour" means "Deal (1d4) poison damage to ally unless constitution save against (11). Apply poisoned to ally for 3 turns unless constitution save against (11).".
  Thing crock "the split preservative crock" on name_way {
    State venting dangerous "A split preservative crock sits under a tilting floorboard. Greenish dust traces the floor.".
    State pinned "The floorboard under the crock is nailed down. Nothing will vent.".
    State emptied "The crock has vented. The air is stale, but clear.".
    Change pin "Pin the tilting floorboard" from venting to pinned needing trapwork after learning vapour_warning.
    Hurts with kitchen_vapour when venting then emptied.
  }
  Hazard shutter_blow "The bronze burial shutters" means "Deal (1d8) physical damage to ally unless dexterity save against (13).".
  Thing shutters "the bronze burial shutters" on shutter_way {
    State armed dangerous "Articulated bronze shutters hang over the passage to the founders' gallery, poised to strike.".
    State pinned "The shutters' release is pinned. They hang still.".
    State sprung "The shutters have struck and jammed half-open.".
    Change pin "Pin the shutter release" from armed to pinned needing trapwork after learning shutter_warning.
    Change brace "Brace the shutters with a line" from armed to pinned needing rope after learning shutter_warning.
    Hurts with shutter_blow when armed then sprung.
  }

  Person custodian "the Mortuary Custodian" at court {
    Role "the keepers' funerary guardian". Species bronze_construct. Level 5.
    State guarding blocking "The Custodian stands across the vault gate, bronze fingers folded.".
    State admitting "The Custodian has stepped aside from the vault gate. It still watches.".
    Guards vault_gate.
    Change admit "Show {self} the keepers' custody writ" from guarding to admitting after learning custody_writ.
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(custodian) to 120.
  Topic custodian_demand with custodian "Address the Mortuary Custodian" when able(custodian) {
    Says "Bronze fingers fold. 'CUSTODY IS NOT CONQUEST. NAME THE DEAD. BEAR THE KEEPER'S WRIT. OR RETURN BY THE WAY YOU CAME.' The same words are cut into its breastplate.".
  }

  Discovery crawl_known "A tram crawl runs from the dry stores to the back of the hoist room; it is marked on a surveyor's board." {
    Source survey_board "a scratched survey board" at vestibule readable by party.
  }
  Discovery hoist_warning "The hoist counterweight releases when the cable takes weight. A trapwork hand can pin it; a line can lash it. Otherwise whoever goes first takes the risk." {
    Source scored_timber "a scored warning on the hoist timber" at hoist readable by party.
  }
  Discovery vapour_warning "The split crock vents poison when its floorboard tilts. A trapwork hand can pin the board. An antidote treats the poison afterwards." {
    Source crock_label "a preservative crock's warning label" at kitchen readable by party.
  }
  Discovery shutter_warning "The bronze shutter strikes an unready intruder. Its release can be pinned or braced with a line. The court itself is safe to stand in." {
    Source shutter_scratches "old scratches by the shutter release" at court readable by party.
  }
  Discovery chalk_exit "A chalk fault runs from the founders' gallery up to the drain mouth. Once learned, it is a way home." {
    Source survey_scratches "a chalk survey scratched on the wall" at chalk readable by party.
  }
  Entity register_pages: source "the register's waxed pages".
  Initially Assert at(register_pages, name_room). Initially Assert intact(register_pages). Initially Assert noticeable(register_pages).
  Initially Assert reveals(register_pages, register_survives). Initially Assert mayExamine(party, register_pages).
  Entity stair_known: fact "A concealed stair joins the name room and the family crypt".
  Entity lantern_letters: source "names written in funeral light".
  Initially Assert established(stair_known). Initially Assert at(lantern_letters, name_room). Initially Assert intact(lantern_letters).
  Initially Assert reveals(lantern_letters, stair_known). Initially Assert mayExamine(party, lantern_letters).
  Rule lit_letters when at(party, name_room) and capable(party, reading_the_dead) { Assert noticeable(lantern_letters). }
  Action puzzle_script(actor: group) "Puzzle out the compact's old script on the rear wall" {
    Description "Someone who reads old hands can make out what the faint lettering says, without the lantern's light.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, name_room) and at(lantern_letters, name_room) and capable(actor, lore)
      and not knows(actor, stair_known).
    Time 2.
    On success { Assert knows(actor, stair_known). }
    Result "Letter by letter, in the old compact hand: the names of the sheltered dead, and among them a line that is not a name. It says the stair behind the shelves goes down to the family crypt.".
  }
  Rule dark_letters when not capable(party, reading_the_dead) { Retract noticeable(lantern_letters). }

  Observe yard_scene at yard when true "Rusting tram rails cross an ash-grown yard. A roofless arch opens into the upper works. A surveyor's scratches mark a climb up the hoist side; without a proper harness it is too exposed.".
  Observe drain_scene at drain_mouth when true "A broken culvert breathes cold air out of the hillside. Water already runs ankle-deep along its floor.".
  Observe vestibule_scene at vestibule when true "Lime-washed walls, a fallen lamp bracket, and footprints in the dust heading deeper in.".
  Observe workshop_scene at workshop when true "Half-cast bells lean against the walls. Chalk circles mark reusable bronze; older burial marks below the stores door declare another custody. Doorways lead to the stores and the vestibule; steps go down to the casting gallery, and the culvert mouth gapes in the floor.".
  Observe stores_scene at stores when true "Collapsed shelving and oilcloth bundles. A soot-black dry stair goes down to the refuge. The far wall is old brick with a low, black opening at its foot.".
  Observe boiler_scene at boiler when true "A wheel valve and a row of cold boilers fill the room. The workshop arch leads back; a narrow pipe walk reaches the casting gallery.".
  Observe gallery_scene at gallery when true "Ceramic moulds stand in rows beneath a broken roof. The far end narrows into the hoist passage.".
  Observe hoist_scene at hoist when true "A slack cable hangs from the hoist drum. Timber and tools lie where a rack came down. The shaft drops to the refuge.".
  Observe hall_scene at hall when true "Three settlements carved their household tallies on the refuge pillars. This was a shelter before it was an ossuary. The dry stair, the hoist landing, the kitchens and the sluice walk all meet here.".
  Observe landing_scene at landing when true "The hoist cage has sunk into gravel. A narrow crawl joins the flood hall.".
  Observe kitchen_scene at kitchen when true "Cold hearths and broken crocks. A passage leads on to the name room.".
  Observe name_room_scene at name_room when true "Waxed shelves and a funeral lampstand occupy the dry wall.".
  Observe faint_letters at name_room when not capable(party, reading_the_dead) "Tiny lettering shines faintly on the rear wall, too faint to read by ordinary light.".
  Observe lit_letters_scene at name_room when capable(party, reading_the_dead) "In the lantern's consecrated light, names written on the rear wall stand out clearly, and an arrow among them points behind the shelves.".
  Observe sluice_scene at sluice when true "Stone gutters run through the refuge. Flood marks record the river's rises. A limestone stair goes down.".
  Observe lower_scene at lower when true "River-smoothed limestone steps turn toward the family crypt. Cold incense hangs in the air.".
  Observe crypt_scene at crypt when true "Small alcoves hold bundled remains under numbered tiles. The court arch stands ahead. A cleft drops toward the founders' gallery; it needs a harness.".
  Observe court_scene at court when true "A bronze dais rises beneath articulated burial shutters. The vault gate lies beyond the dais; a shuttered passage leads aside to the founders' gallery.".
  Observe vault_scene at vault when true "Named stone drawers stand in order, each cut with a family number.".
  Observe founders_scene at founders when true "Three bronze founders hold tools rather than crowns. Their plinths name the flood compact of Reedwake, Chalkcross and Brackenholt. A chalk passage leads upward.".
  Observe chalk_scene at chalk when true "A pale fault runs upward through the chalk. Your old footprints are undisturbed in the dust.".
  Observe guardian_dead at court when dead(custodian) "The Custodian lies still. Its burial chain hangs severed from a bronze hand. The vault is open, and the keepers have no guardian here now.".
  Goal false.
}

Module silkholme "Silkholme sink" {
  Description "A chalk sinkhole on the ridge above Reedwake. Its lip is quiet grass; below, the chalk opens into caves that something has hung with silk.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place march "The region" is region.
  Place ridge "The high approach" is room.

  Place silkholme "Silkholme sink" is site within march at 3, 0.
  Place lip "the lip of the sink" is room within silkholme at 0, 0.
  Place frames "the frame terrace" is room within silkholme at 1, 0.
  Place caves "The caves below" is level within silkholme.
  Place cave "the lower cave" is room within caves at 0, 1.
  Place nest "the nest" is room within caves at 1, 1.
  Initially Assert unlit(cave). Initially Assert unlit(nest).

  Passage sink_path "the sink path" is path between ridge and lip taking 30 minutes.
  Passage terrace_steps "the terrace steps" is path between lip and frames.
  Passage shaft "the sink shaft" is climb between lip and cave needing rope or climbing.
  Passage seep "the seep crawl" is crawl between frames and cave taking 1 hour.
  Passage web_gallery "the web gallery" is passage between cave and nest.

  Observe sink_lip at lip when true "The grass runs right to the edge and stops. Below, the chalk drops into a round shaft, white at the top and grey further down, and cool air comes up out of it.".
  Observe frame_terrace at frames when true "A ledge cut into the side of the sink, sheltered from the wind. A wet fissure at the back of the ledge breathes cave air.".
  Observe lower_cave at cave when true "Water drips from the chalk into shallow pools. Pale threads run along the walls towards a low arch, and every thread trembles a little.".

}

Module skellfold "Skellfold and the high quarry" {
  Description "A slate-quarrying hamlet under the fell, and the old workings above it, in the first week of snow.".

  Place fells "The Skell fells" is region.
  Place hamlet "Skellfold" is settlement within fells at 0, 0.

  Place cottage_room "the cottage" is room within cottage at 0, 0.
  Place chapel "the fell chapel" is room within chapel_house at 2, 0.
  Place green "Skellfold green" is room within hamlet at 1, 0.
  Place lane_foot "the foot of the beck lane" is room within fellside at 0, 1.
  Place fell_track "the shepherds' track" is room within fellside at 0, 0.
  Place quarry_floor "the quarry floor" is room within quarry at 0, 1.
  Place smithy "the quarry smithy" is room within quarry at 0, 0.
  Place adit "the adit mouth" is room within workings at 1, 1.

  Passage cottage_door "the cottage door" is door between cottage_room and green.
  Passage chapel_door "the chapel door" is door between chapel and green.
  Passage drift_seal "the sealed drift" is drift between lower_gallery and drowned_drift.
  Passage beck_path "the path along the beck" is path between green and lane_foot taking 30 minutes.
  Passage beck_lane "the beck lane" is track between lane_foot and quarry_floor taking 30 minutes.
  Passage fell_climb "the fell climb" is path between green and fell_track taking 1 hour.
  Passage fell_descent "the quarry track" is track between fell_track and quarry_floor taking 1 hour.
  Passage smithy_door "the smithy door" is door between quarry_floor and smithy.
  Passage adit_mouth "the adit" is tunnel between quarry_floor and adit.

  Passage ladder_shaft "the ladder shaft" is ladder between upper_gallery and lower_gallery.
  Passage incline_way "the side drift" is drift between adit and incline_top.
  Passage tub_incline "the tub incline" is incline between incline_top and lower_gallery.

  Hazard ladder_fall "A fall from a rotten ladder" means "Deal (1d6) physical damage to ally unless dexterity save against (12).".
  Thing ladder "the rotten ladder" on ladder_shaft {
    State rotten dangerous "A ladder of soft, black wood goes down the shaft. Two rungs are already gone.".
    State braced "A line runs from a piton beside the shaft down along the ladder, lashed at every third rung.".
    State broken blocking "The ladder hangs in pieces at the bottom of the shaft.".
    Hurts with ladder_fall when rotten then broken.
    Change brace "Lash {self} to a line before anyone climbs" from rotten to braced needing rope.
  }
  Item coil "a coil of line" is rope at smithy.

  Person smith "Hob" at smithy {
    Role "quarry smith". Ancestry dwarf. Calling warrior. Level 2. Peaceable. Background miner.
  }
  Person sexton "Gethin" at chapel {
    Role "sexton of the fell chapel". Ancestry dwarf. Calling cleric. Trait vitalist. Level 2. Profession priest. Peaceable.
  }
  Topic sexton_drift with sexton "Ask Gethin about the quarry" when true {
    Says "'Nine men were drowned in the lower drift when the beck broke in,' says Gethin. 'We could not bring them up, so we sealed it and said the words over the seal. That drift is consecrated ground, whatever a lease says.'".
  }
  Company party "Your company" of 3 at green.
  Initially Set quantity(party, gold) to 6. Initially Set quantity(party, rations) to 1.
  Topic smith_ladder with smith "Ask Hob about the workings" when true {
    Says "'Ladder down to the lower gallery's rotten. Has been for years. Take a line if you go down it. Or go round by the side drift and the tub incline; it's longer, but it'll hold you.'".
  }

  Observe cottage_scene at cottage_room when true "Peat smoke, a tally-stick rack by the door, and a window that looks straight up the fell at the quarry.".
  Observe green_scene at green when true "Snow lies thin on the green and thick on the walls. The beck path runs up the valley; a steep track climbs the fellside.".
  Observe lane_scene at lane_foot when true "The beck lane climbs between drystone walls toward the quarry. Snow is already curling over the walls into it.".
  Observe track_scene at fell_track when true "Wind, and a long view of grey fell. The track drops toward the quarry from above.".
  Observe floor_scene at quarry_floor when true "Spoil heaps, a smithy with cold chimney, and the black mouth of the adit in the quarry face.".
  Observe smithy_scene at smithy when true "Tongs, wedges, a cold forge.".
  Observe adit_scene at adit when true "The adit runs straight into the hill. A side drift slopes away to the left.".
  Observe upper_scene at upper_gallery when true "A wide gallery of split slate. In the floor, a square shaft drops into darkness.".
  Observe chapel_scene at chapel when true "A low slate chapel. Nine names are cut into the lintel, newer than the rest.".
  Observe drift_scene at drowned_drift when true "Water stands knee-deep. Tally sticks and a few small things were left on a ledge above it, out of the wet.".
  Observe incline_scene at incline_top when true "Rails run steeply down into the dark: the old tub incline.".
  Observe lower_scene at lower_gallery when true "Low and wet. Rails end in a tangle where an ore tub has jumped them.".
  Goal false.
}
